title: Section 75 — Power of Court to issue commissions — CPC 1908

content.heading: Power of Court to issue commissions
content.text: Subject to such conditions and limitations as may be prescribed, the Court may issue a commission to examine any person; to make a local investigation; to examine or adjust accounts; to make a partition; to hold a scientific, technical or expert investigation; to conduct sale of property which is subject to speedy and natural decay and which is in the custody of the Court pending the determination of the suit; or to perform any ministerial act.
